incident_updates.body:
Our Engineering team has confirmed that the increased error rates in the SFO3 region are resolved.

From 02:53 UTC to 04:32 UTC, users may have experienced errors, timeouts, or delays when creating or managing Droplets, Volumes, Load Balancers, Reserved IPs, Cloud Firewalls, Managed Databases, and M...

Our Engineering team has mitigated the issue, and services in the SFO3 region are currently operating normally. The team is continuing to monitor the situation to ensure stability given the scope of the impact.

We will continue monitoring and share another update once the situation is fully resolve...
